trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands automatically once the other 54 trophies are yours, so there is nothing to do for it directly. Work through the roadmap in this guide — story first, then side characters, activities, robberies and collectibles — and check the in-game 100% completion list before your final cleanup, since A Long Road is the last big gate before this pops.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: play the opening mission Gone Fishing and finish it. It is the first mission of the game, so this is one of the earliest trophies you will earn; just follow the mission prompts and see it through to the end.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish every mission in Chapter 1. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter anyway — the game has no mission replay, so a save at each chapter start is cheap insurance for the one trophy that can be missed later (Positive Mental Attitude).

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish every mission in Chapter 2. This is the chapter where both Jason and Lucia become playable together, which opens up most of the free-roam trophies — use the gaps between missions to start on activities and collectibles rather than rushing straight through.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish every mission in Chapter 3. Robbery trophies start opening up in Chapters 3 and 4, so from here on, try the robbery side content as it appears instead of leaving it all for after the story.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish every mission in Chapter 4. Before you push into the final stretch, make a manual save — there is no mission replay, and a save before the final mission protects you if anything in the endgame goes wrong.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: finish the final mission and watch the credits roll. It is one of only two gold trophies, and it unlocks the post-game world where the 100% completion checklist opens up — most of the cleanup trophies are best done after this point, when the whole map and all activities are available.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete the mission Breakfast Run when it comes up in the story. Just play the mission through; there is no special condition beyond finishing it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete the story heist mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions tend to be long, so set aside a proper session and follow the crew's plan as it unfolds.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete the mission Child's Play in the story. No extra requirement — finishing the mission is the whole job.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete the mission Headliners in the story. Play it through to its conclusion and the trophy follows.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete the mission VCIA Takedown in the story. It takes place around the airport, so it pairs naturally with the free-roam airport trophy Catch Me If You Can — but the mission itself only asks you to finish it.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable: complete the mission Operation Savage Glory in the story. A late-story mission, so by the time it appears you will be well stocked — play it through and the trophy is yours.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set and the second gold: reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which opens after the story (earlier progress still counts). The checklist covers story, side missions, activities, collectibles and stunts — Push Square and GTABase both put the platinum at around 200 hours, most of it here. Work from the checklist itself, a category at a time, and use this guide's tracker to tick off the counted trophies (250 stunts, 42 shooting-range golds, 100 WAiNK scans) as you go.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 unique stunts across Leonida — stunt jumps, flights under bridges, knife flights and base jumps. PowerPyx counts 397 stunts in the game, so you need a little over half of them, and 100% completion needs 300. Stunts are tracked in the pause menu, so check your count there and mop up the easiest remaining ones (ramps and bridge flights) in free roam after the story.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of leisure activity once — GTABase counts 9 types. This is a sampler, not a grind: play one round of each activity the game offers (races, drone races, fishing, arcade games, shooting range and the rest) and the trophy pops. Do it early, while you are learning the map, and it doubles as a tour of what the game has to offer.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — the count comes from PSN's tracker. This is a skill trophy, not a luck one: learn each challenge's scoring, pick the right weapon for the range, and replay the ones you miss until gold. The range is available from early on, so practise a few challenges between story missions instead of leaving all 42 for the end.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every drone-race location. Drone races are short, so the grind is travel, not racing: visit each location, win once, and move on. If a location keeps beating you, learn its course line first at low speed, then run it flat out.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same race 20 times. Work through the race list across Leonida, varying vehicle classes so you are not stuck on one type. Short circuit races are the fastest wins; save the long point-to-point ones for when you know the roads.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is a timing activity: watch the line tension, reel steadily rather than mashing, and pick your moment to strike. If you lose, the challenge can be retried — treat the first attempt as practice for Cal's patterns.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete a single arcade game at an arcade. Any game counts and you do not need a high score — just see one through to its end. A quick trophy to grab while passing an arcade in free roam.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Side-character trophy: finish Andy's whole mission strand, ending with his final mission. Side strands unlock as the story progresses, so check the map for Andy's icon between story missions and clear his jobs as they appear rather than saving them all for the post-game.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Side-character trophy: finish Kenton's whole mission strand, ending with his final mission. Kenton's jobs involve boats and the water, so keep a fast boat handy when his icon appears on the map.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Side-character trophy: finish Billy's whole mission strand, ending with his final mission. Billy's strand is bike-flavoured — a good handling bike and a clear road make his jobs much easier.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full mission strands for strangers across Leonida — the classic GTA side-mission format. Stranger icons appear on the map as you explore; each strand is several missions long, so start them early and finish one strand before starting the next to keep track. The five named side characters (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) have their own trophies, and this one covers the wider stranger cast.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Side-character trophy: finish Randy's whole mission strand, ending with his final mission. Randy's jobs revolve around supply runs — bring a roomy, fast vehicle and expect cargo to matter more than firepower.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Side-character trophy: finish Tyrone's whole mission strand, ending with his final mission. Work through his jobs as they appear on the map; like the other side strands, the final mission only unlocks once the earlier ones are done.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE missable trophy — the only one on the list reported as missable. Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida (18 spots, per KeenGamer), and one of them — Lucia's balcony spot in Chapter 1 — disappears after that chapter ends. Meditate at every spot you find as soon as you find it, and never leave Chapter 1 without checking the balcony spot. There is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter; if you miss the Chapter 1 spot, only that save (or a new playthrough) can recover it.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Side-character trophy: hunt a unique animal for Bret. Hunting needs patience more than firepower — track the animal, approach downwind and quietly, and take a clean shot. Bret's hunts are one-off encounters, so read his instructions before you start moving.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — shops, hidden spots and mission rewards are the usual places — so pick up every card you pass rather than hunting one set at a time. Track which sets are close to complete and finish those first; a set only counts once every card in it is found.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK phone app at 100 locations — GTABase breaks them down as 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags. WAiNK is the in-game scanner: open it, point it at a landmark, curiosity or sculpture and log it. Any 100 count, so sweep the city centre and the coast first where locations are dense, and save the remote ones for your exploration pass.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges — the game's checklist of small feats across combat, driving, exploration and more. Challenges complete naturally as you play everything else, so check the challenge list in the pause menu regularly and steer toward the ones nearest done. Fifty is a lot, but you will be well on the way by the time the story ends.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then lose it completely. The trick is the escape, not the wanted level: start somewhere with fast getaway routes and a fast car parked nearby, earn the fourth star, then break line of sight, switch vehicles and lay low until the stars clear. Do it with your partner in the car — the trophy needs you both in it together.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level — the wanted level must stay on the whole time, so this is a speed run, not a stealth one. Pick three shops close together, plan the route in advance, keep a fast getaway car at the kerb, and hit each shop fast: in, take the cash, out, next shop. If the stars clear between shops, the chain breaks and you start again.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — scan them with the WAiNK app, and you do not need to drive them. GTABase notes the 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so this trophy comes on the way to that. The fastest method is to stand by a busy road and scan passing traffic; car parks and highways beat quiet back roads for variety.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus (the slow-motion aiming mode). Set it up rather than hoping for it: find a spot with a cluster of enemies, trigger Combat Focus with a full meter, and work through targets quickly — headshots keep the chain going. A busy shootout in a story mission is the easiest place to line five up at once.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — in plain terms, steal a plane and take off without following the airport's rules. Get airside, grab a plane on the runway or apron, and get airborne. Expect the police to object; a fast take-off and a climb away from the airport is the whole plan. How exactly the game counts an 'unscheduled' departure is not yet pinned down by the guides, so treat this as an experiment: take off from the runway without clearance and see it pop.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke, not an instruction: 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' points at the Rhino tank. The working reading from the guides is that this trophy involves getting into, or surviving in, a Rhino tank — but no guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet. Try acquiring a Rhino in free roam (military areas are the obvious place to look) and driving it around; if that does not pop it, the trigger is likely a specific tank stunt or survival challenge, and the guides will pin it down as players test it.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — a stealth robbery, so plan it like one. Scout the store first, learn the guard and camera positions, move quietly, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the attempt fails: leave, let the heat die down, and try again with a better route.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Bank vaults are the big robberies of the free-roam set: bring a fast car, plan the escape route before you go in, and do not linger once the vault is open. Each vault counts only if you get away clean, so treat the escape as half the job and space the five vaults across your post-story cleanup.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape — a nod to the classic GTA V heist. Armored trucks patrol the roads; force one to stop, crack it open, take the cash and get away before the police box you in. Pick a quiet stretch of road with a fast escape route, and have your getaway car ready before you start.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every region of Leonida until the map is fully revealed. The game tracks which areas you have visited, so drive, fly and sail through the whole state — the cities, the swamps, the coast and the islands. The easiest way is a long road trip after the story, ticking off grey areas on the map one by one; the WAiNK and meditation sweeps cover much of the same ground, so combine them.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Each gang runs its own off-the-books operations — find them, hit one per gang, and get out. Gang territory matters here: expect armed resistance, so go in with a plan and a fast exit rather than wandering in cold.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — a quiet moment trophy, not a fight. Head to a bar or beach spot on Ocean Beach with a view of the water, order a cocktail and take it in. It is one of the game's small 'be there' trophies; the exact venue is not yet pinned down by the guides, so try the beachfront bars along Ocean Drive and the trophy should pop when you find the right seat.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: 'Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style' is a direct nod to the old GTA showroom smash. Drive a car into a vehicle showroom, then drive it straight back out through the glass. Any showroom should do, but the bigger the window, the cleaner the exit — line the car up before you go in, then floor it through the front.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates’ bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — go bowling there. 'Follow-through' suggests finishing a full game rather than one throw, so play a complete game at that alley and the trophy should follow. It is another nod to GTA IV's bowling, and a gentle one: any score counts as long as you finish.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal — the description hints at doing something with your partner that draws a crowd. No guide has confirmed the exact trigger yet: the likeliest readings are a co-op activity done well with your partner, or a shared moment that goes public in-game. Treat this as unconfirmed for now and check the guides again once players have pinned it down; do not grind blindly for it.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made, for better or worse — this trophy is tied to a story choice. The game presents decisions that change how scenes play out; make one and see it through. Which choice, and whether it can be missed, is not yet confirmed by the guides. Keep a manual save before any big decision in the story so you can revisit it if this trophy does not pop on your first run.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: 'Second time's the charm' — this trophy is about succeeding on a second attempt at something you failed first. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed: it may be retrying a failed activity, mission or challenge and passing it the second time. Play naturally and it may pop on its own; if it does not, retrying a failed challenge immediately is the most likely trigger to test.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: 'What the hell just happened?' points at a UFO or paranormal easter egg — the classic GTA secret. The exact trigger is not yet confirmed by any guide. Likely candidates are a UFO sighting spot or a strange encounter in the wilderness at night; explore the game's odd corners after dark and keep an eye on the sky. Do not trust a specific location until a guide confirms it with a screenshot.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl ’em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by: from a moving vehicle, knock down bowling pins — or people — with a melee weapon. A drive-by usually means a gun, so this one is deliberately odd: equip a melee weapon, drive past a group (or a set of pins) and swing as you pass. A busy pavement at low speed gives you the best chance of connecting with several targets in one pass.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; your contacts clean them for a cut, and the trophy counts the cleaned total. Keep robbing (banks, trucks, shops) and laundering steadily through the game rather than saving it all for the end — $250,000 is a lot of dirty money to wash in one go.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida — clothes, weapons, cars, food, everything counts. You will get most of the way there just by gearing up for the story and the robberies; if you are short at the end, buy big-ticket items (a car or high-end weapons) rather than grinding small purchases. Track your spend in the pause menu stats.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property in the game. Garages are bought through the in-game property market; each one costs money and gives you storage for your registered vehicles, which ties in with the On the Spot trophy. Buy them as you can afford them — the expensive ones are best left until your robbery income is flowing.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find cars you like in free roam, scan them with WAiNK to check them, then register them as personal vehicles through the app and store them in a garage (see Little Boxes). Ten is a small number — your favourite cars from the story and your WAiNK sweeps will cover it without a dedicated grind.
